## Functional summary

This 588-aa sequence is an **exact, full-length match** to reviewed UniProt protein **Q6G099**, phosphomethylpyrimidine synthase from *Bartonella quintana*. It is annotated as **EC 4.1.99.17** and catalyzes formation of the hydroxymethylpyrimidine-phosphate (HMP-P) moiety used in **thiamine (vitamin B₁) biosynthesis**.

The curated reaction (Rhea **RHEA:24840**) is:

**5-amino-1-(5-phospho-β-D-ribosyl)imidazole (AIR) + S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAM) → 4-amino-2-methyl-5-(phosphooxymethyl)pyrimidine (HMP-P) + CO + 5′-deoxyadenosine + formate + L-methionine + 3 H⁺**

The annotation describes this as a **radical SAM-dependent** reaction requiring a **[4Fe–4S] cluster**. The reference protein is annotated as a homodimer.

**Evidence and caveat:** The functional assignment is unusually strong at the sequence level because the query matches the reviewed reference exactly across its full length. This supports transferring the reference annotation to this sequence, but does not itself constitute a new biochemical assay of the submitted protein.
